title: Workspace asset provenance, idempotency, and object-level read authority

phases.objective: Complete the canonical Resource API asset slice by making the existing durable asset identity idempotent with typed provenance conflicts and by preventing non-owner tenant members from reading Brand-scoped assets without an effective Brand or direct Asset grant.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST/GET /me/workspaces/{tenant_id}/resources/assets through the existing Resource API
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Asset create reuses the unique tenant/type/ref identity only when canonical Brand and provenance are compatible, rejects conflicting checksum/provenance before duplicate persistence, returns only a safe provenance projection, and tenant reads hide Brand-scoped assets unless the member owns/administers the workspace or holds an effective Brand or Asset grant.
steps: Require a durable asset_ref and resolve canonical Brand attachment through the already-merged workspace asset Brand authority.
Lock the existing (tenant_id, asset_type, asset_ref) identity before insert and reuse the row only when Brand and provenance are compatible.
Persist normalized source_type/provider/revision, credential-free source locator, checksum/content identity, ingestion mode, canonical Brand key and original creator evidence in metadata_json.
Reject deleted identity reuse, Brand mismatch, checksum mismatch, source provenance mismatch and sensitive source_uri values with typed failures.
Read the final row back under lock inside the same transaction and prove identity, Brand and content identity before commit.
Expose a safe provenance projection without returning raw metadata_json or raw source_uri.
For non-owner tenant reads, preserve unbranded workspace asset visibility while requiring an effective Brand grant or direct Asset grant for Brand-scoped rows.
Keep owner/admin tenant read authority unchanged and leave the platform-admin surface unchanged.
assertions: The schema-provided unique identity (tenant_id, asset_type, asset_ref) is used as the idempotency key without a migration.
Compatible replay does not issue a second INSERT.
Checksum or source provenance conflict fails closed without duplicate persistence.
Sensitive or signed source_uri material is rejected rather than persisted as provenance.
Brand-scoped list/get queries for non-owner members contain effective Brand and direct Asset grant predicates.
Workspace owner/admin list/get queries do not require redundant object grants.
Raw metadata_json and raw source_uri are not part of the Resource API asset projection.
No new asset endpoint, registry, migration, live SQL Apply, deployment, Production/provider mutation, secret access, external send, or force push is introduced.
